_source: Single source of truth for all three concepts. Identity and proof lines are copied from the live site (fact-checked against the owner's CVs on 2026-10-01). Project figures are measured in a verification pass on 2026-11-21 unless marked 'readme' (stated in the project's own README, not re-measured). Do not add claims that are not here.

projects.name: Multilingual Editorial Automation Platform
projects.tagline: English news in, reviewed Hebrew articles out, with no human typing in between.
projects.blurb: An event-driven publishing pipeline: scheduled ingest, article extraction, structured LLM translation, and a human-approval gate behind Cloudflare Access before anything reaches the public site. Built three times: a local Python prototype, a production Cloudflare engine, and a server-rendered Hebrew site.
projects._rule: Unbranded. Never name the client, brand, domain or org.

projects.name: FinPulse
projects.tagline: Portfolio, market data and alerts on one serverless screen.
projects.blurb: A financial intelligence platform: a React 19 front end on a serverless AWS backbone, real-time market data, holdings, whale alerts and an AI copilot, shipped through separate CI, security and deploy pipelines.

projects.name: CMA: Cost Monitoring Agent
projects.tagline: Know which agent spent the money, and why the bill moved.
projects.blurb: Self-hosted cost observability for multi-agent LLM systems: spend captured at the call site and attributed per agent, model and provider, budgets and alerts, and a RAG assistant that explains changes in plain language.

projects.name: CISO Agent
projects.tagline: A security officer inside every coding agent's loop.
projects.blurb: A Claude Code plugin: before an agent runs a command or pushes code, a local hook identifies the local account and lets 20 fixed rules decide. The plugin needs no server and no model in the decision path; editing the shipped ruleset makes every decision fail closed.

figures.label: deliberately broken rules caught by tests

projects.status: Built and tested; not yet deployed

projects.name: Aegis
projects.tagline: Crash-test agents before they ship.
projects.blurb: An agent reliability platform: runs an agent against versioned scenarios in sandboxes with simulated tools and injected faults, compares baseline with candidate, and gates releases through a separate approver role. Exports OpenTelemetry.

projects.name: Free Kick
projects.tagline: Swipe, bend, score. It works offline.
projects.blurb: A mobile football game that installs from the browser and plays without a connection. Swipe direction aims, speed is power, a curved swipe bends the ball.

projects.name: Happiness bakery
projects.tagline: A Hebrew storefront for a custom cake bakery.
projects.blurb: A right-to-left single-page site for a bento cake bakery: gallery with keyboard and touch lightbox, scroll-triggered reveals, glass-card UI.

projects.name: Cardwatch
projects.tagline: Price alerts only when they matter.
projects.blurb: A calm price-awareness assistant for collectible cards: owned cards alert on a meaningful rise, wanted cards on a meaningful drop. It surfaces moves; it never buys or sells.

projects.name: Personal Agent System
projects.tagline: My own agent estate, with an authority model, audits and backups.
projects.blurb: A self-run agent system where permissions are tiered in a ledger that code enforces, a read-only local dashboard, a task queue to cloud agents, and a backup design that keeps secrets out of git.

projects.name: Automated Video Studio
projects.tagline: An AI studio that ships a clay-animation series.
projects.blurb: A three-engine production line: Claude for story and orchestration, generative media plus ffmpeg for assembly, and platform APIs for publishing and measurement, sharing one record per episode with review and ship gates.

projects.name: Citation-Checked RAG
projects.tagline: Answers about privacy policies, with every quote checked.
projects.blurb: Fully local retrieval over 14 privacy policies and key GDPR articles. After generation, every citation and verbatim quote is checked against the retrieved text, and anything unverifiable is flagged.

projects.name: EdgeKeeper
projects.tagline: A trading core that refuses bad trades.
projects.blurb: Every order passes a fail-closed risk gate, limits are frozen with hard ceilings in code, and circuit breakers stay tripped until a person resets them. Every hard ceiling is pinned by boundary tests that catch even a tiny loosening.

figures.label: deliberately broken risk limits caught by tests

projects.name: Market-making validator
projects.tagline: Kill the bad idea before it costs money.
projects.blurb: A paper-only kill-filter that returns GO, KILL or INCONCLUSIVE on a market-making thesis before any capital is at risk. Dry-run by default; live trading hard-blocked.
